- 2028 ÷ 100 = 20.28, so it's not a century year that needs to be divisible by 400
- Therefore, 2028 is a leap year

Now I'll count backwards 205 days from October 3, 2028:

October 2028: 3 days (Oct 3, 2, 1) = 3 days
September 2028: 30 days (full month)
August 2028: 31 days (full month)

Total so far: 3 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 = 186 days

Remaining: 205 - 186 = 19 days

So I need to go back 19 more days into March 2028:
March 2028: 31 days (full month)

Going back 19 days from April 1, 2028:
April 1 minus 19 days = March 31 minus 18 days = March 13, 2028

Let me verify by counting forward from March 13, 2028 to October 3, 2028:
- March 13 to March 31: 18 days (31 - 13 = 18)
- April: 30 days
- May: 31 days
- June: 30 days

- September: 30 days
- October 1 to October 3: 3 days

Total: 18 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 3 = 204 days

That's 204 days, so I need one more day back: March 12, 2028

Let me recount from March 12:
- March 12 to March 31: 19 days (31 - 12 = 19)
- April: 30 days
- May: 31 days
- June: 30 days
- July: 31 days
- August: 31 days
- September: 30 days
- October 1 to October 3: 3 days

Total: 19 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 3 = 205 days ✓

ANSWER: 2028-03-12
